    car_patches = image_patch.find("black car")
    if not car_patches: return image_patch
    
    main_road_patches = image_patch.find("main road")
    if not main_road_patches: return car_patches[0]
    
    main_road = main_road_patches[0]
    right_side = order_from([main_road], "right")[0]
    
    driving_on_main_road = [car for car in car_patches if car.overlaps_with(right_side.left, right_side.lower, right_side.right, right_side.upper)]
    
    return driving_on_main_road[0] if driving_on_main_road else car_patches[0]
